reason: 55 crowns for one can is almost double what I pay per can for a Monster or Big Shock 4-pack on offer, and I can already get yerba mate cheaper on Rohlík. On my money that's not a weekly thing, it's not even a treat.
objection: Every brand says natural now. Paying 55 a can plus e-shop delivery for something I can get cheaper elsewhere makes no sense to me.
would_change_my_mind: A multipack deal that brings it to around 30 CZK a can, ideally on Rohlík or in a supermarket on offer.
